summary: Defines the Delegation Signer (DS) resource record, placed at a zone cut to show that the delegated zone is signed and that a given key is valid for it. It modified the original DNSSEC design for operational reasons. It has been replaced by RFCs 4033, 4034 and 4035.

eli5.summary: A parent folder tells you which stamp the child folder uses to prove its papers are real. That note is the DS record. Later documents, RFCs 4033 to 4035, replaced this one.

questions: how does dnssec link parent and child zones
